$schema: Brand guidelines for OpenCraft document-agent. Single source of design truth for all generated SPH/MoU/Deck output. Aligned to https://opencraft-landing.netlify.app (extracted 2026-05-13).

company.name: OpenCraft
company.positioning: Senior-led AI transformation for teams that need strategy, workflow design, and operational rollout to move as one system.
value_props: Design, deploy, and scale intelligent models that automate complex workflows

voice.tone: Profesional, percaya diri, senior-led. Hindari pemasaran berlebihan; tunjukkan keahlian melalui spesifik.
do: Gunakan istilah AI Consulting, IT Consulting, AI Transformation
Sebut tech stack spesifik (LangGraph, RAG, LangChain) bila relevan
Cantumkan PIC (Person in Charge) untuk semua engagement
dont: Pakai bahasa kasual / slang dalam dokumen resmi

primary.name: Brand Blue
primary.usage: CTAs, section headings, table headers, accent borders, party-box left border, key brand accent

accent.name: AI Green
accent.usage: AI/automation emphasis, success states, secondary highlights

bgInverted.name: Inverted BG
bgInverted.usage: Closing slide background, hero negative space

typography.web_font: Plus Jakarta Sans (fallback: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)
typography.pdf_font: Helvetica (react-pdf built-in; can be upgraded via Font.register('Plus Jakarta Sans', ttfUrl))
typography.ppt_font: Calibri (closest cross-platform match to Plus Jakarta Sans available natively in PowerPoint)

logo.clear_space: Minimum 24pt on all sides — never crowd

placement.sph: Centered, height 60pt at top of first page
placement.mou: Centered, height 60pt at top of first page

dont: Don't recolor — always use the original file
Don't place on non-white background without contrast test

deck_169.accent_bar: 0.18in tall brand-blue bar across top of every slide

page_break_rules.headings: Always use H2 helper with minPresenceAhead={90} so section titles don't get orphaned
page_break_rules.tables: Wrap each table (and its title) in <View wrap={false}>
page_break_rules.signatures: <View wrap={false}> on the signature block — never split signer name from line

structure: Date line (right-aligned, format: 'City, D Month YYYY' in Bahasa)
3 body paragraphs (OpenCraft intro, services, project pitch)
Party blocks: PIHAK VENDOR + PIHAK KLIEN (boxed, left primary border)
Numbered Poin sections (Kesepakatan, Pembayaran, SOW General/UI-X/Dev)

structure_minimum: Content slides (plain typography in draft; soft-3D fully-designed images after polish)

rendering_modes.draft: pptxgenjs renders pure typography only — no diagrams, charts, decorative shapes, or visual elements. Page chrome (thin top accent bar + small logo + page number + brand strip footer). Used for content review before image generation.
rendering_modes.polished: Each marked content slide is replaced with a single 16:9 PNG generated by fal.ai gpt-image-2. The image contains text + 3D illustration + brand mark, all baked in. pptxgenjs embeds the image full-bleed and skips native rendering for that slide.

illustration_style.name: Soft 3D modern-SaaS (locked)
illustration_style.derived_from: brand/logo.png — three interlocking hands, blue-gradient triangle, single teal-green palm accent

palette_rules.primary_shapes: electric blue (#2563EB) with light-blue (#84A1FF) gradient highlights
palette_rules.accent: exactly ONE teal-green (#10A37F) per slide on the most important focal element — mirrors green palm in logo
palette_rules.shadows: very faint warm slate, soft and diffuse

layout_rules.composition: centered — text frames the hero illustration above and below; never text-left / visual-right
layout_rules.top_bar: thin electric-blue accent bar (~6 px) across the very top of every slide
layout_rules.wordmark: small 'OpenCraft' in deep navy at the bottom-right corner of every slide
layout_rules.whitespace: generous — must feel calm and premium

per_kind_visuals.section: single hero 3D illustration centered, anchored by floor shadow
per_kind_visuals.pillars: horizontal row of soft-3D pillar forms (podium / sphere / prism) — one carries the green accent, others blue-gradient
per_kind_visuals.feature: soft 3D hero illustration of the feature concept — abstract, not a UI mockup
per_kind_visuals.stats: row of 3D rounded-card stat tiles, one with green accent rim/edge
per_kind_visuals.chart: bars as soft rounded 3D prisms, OR donut as glossy 3D torus — single highlighted segment in green
per_kind_visuals.roadmap: horizontal 3D timeline of phase cards connected by a curved 3D path with glowing milestone nodes — one milestone in green

cover_slide.background: white with thin primary-blue accent bar at top
cover_slide.tagline: next to logo, uppercase, charSpacing 4, textMuted
cover_slide.title: centered or left-aligned, bold, 44pt, ink color
cover_slide.subtitle: below title, 17pt, textMuted
